title: 第26章 请道友传法
content_zh:
月光透过窗棂，在青砖地上投下斑驳碎影。

    灯油在摇晃中溅出几点暗红，将李老道那张沟壑纵横的老脸映得愈发狰狞。

    韩榆听到完他说的话，又见他浑身浓郁血腥气息，心中不敢放松警惕。

    “道爷，你有魔血门的修炼正篇？”

    “原来没有，今日杀了灵兽宗的弟子张山，便有了。”李老道。

    韩榆更是愕然：“张山？灵兽宗？”

    “不错，正是灵兽宗。”

    “青禾坊市对外交流方便，与此同时也方便外面宗门联系万春谷的弟子，所以我才有机会接触魔血门的人，张山才有机会成为灵兽宗的弟子，学会驯养偷灵鼠的手段！”

    李老道嘶哑着声音，为韩榆解释：“你以为张山是什么好人吗？又是给刘兰灵石，又是供刘兰修炼，所求无非是打动刘兰，让刘兰这个以后的外门弟子给他大开方便之门，甚至想让刘兰做他道侣……”

    又冷笑说道：“这小子倒也机灵，最近几天察觉到不对劲，给我下套，说是韦坤仪那个女人豢养偷灵鼠，还说他自己亲眼所见，要我跟他一起向王管事举报韦坤仪。”

    “欺我刚入门，不知道韦坤仪那女人实则是王管事的禁脔，不知道豢养偷灵鼠的是他张山，想要让我触碰王管事的霉头！”

    “他既然也心怀不轨，我更不必犹豫！”

    “今日便将他带去青禾坊市，与魔血门的人一起把他杀了！顺便以此换取炼血功正篇修炼之法，借助他浑身灵血，一举踏过修行门槛，抵达练血一层！”

    说到这里，情绪忍不住高昂，握紧双手，红白相间的头发飘舞，浑身腥风鼓荡。

    “小娃儿，我练血一层了！”

    韩榆听他描述，也感觉曲折艰辛。

    “道爷，你这一路行来，当真不易，如今终于得偿所愿。”

    “是啊，终于得偿所愿！”李老道两眼血红，死死盯着韩榆，如同饥饿的虎狼。

    忽然意识到不妥，迅速掐手诀，片刻之后长长呼出一口气：“这魔血门的功法快是快了点，但这渴求血食、气息躁动，非得时刻以敛息术遮掩不可。”

    韩榆问道：“道爷今晚为何来找我？”
content_en:
The moonlight shines through the window lattice, casting mottled shadows on the blue brick floor.

The lamp oil splashed out a few dots of dark red as it shook, making Li Laodao's old face with crisscrossed ravines even more ferocious.

After Han Yu heard what he said and saw the strong smell of blood all over his body, he did not dare to let down his guard.

"Master Tao, do you have the main chapter on Demon Blood Sect's cultivation?"

"It turns out there is no such thing. Today I killed Zhang Shan, a disciple of the Spiritual Beast Sect, and that's what happened." Old Li said.

Han Yu was even more stunned: "Zhang Shan? Spiritual Beast Sect?"

"Yes, it is the Spiritual Beast Sect."

"Qinghefang City is convenient for foreign exchanges. At the same time, it is also convenient for outside sects to contact the disciples of Wanchun Valley. That's why I have the opportunity to contact people from the Demon Blood Sect, and Zhang Shan has the opportunity to become a disciple of the Spirit Beast Sect and learn how to tame spirit-stealing rats!"

Li Laodao explained to Han Yu in a hoarse voice: "Do you think Zhang Shan is a good person? He gave Liu Lan spiritual stones and helped Liu Lan practice. All he wanted was to impress Liu Lan and let Liu Lan, the future outer disciple, open the door for him. He even wanted Liu Lan to be his Taoist companion..."

Then he sneered and said: "This kid is quite clever. He has noticed something is wrong in the past few days and set a trap for me. He said that the woman Wei Kunyi was raising spirit-stealing rats. He also said that he saw it with his own eyes and asked me to report Wei Kunyi to Manager Wang together with him."

"I was just starting out. I didn't know that the woman Wei Kunyi was actually Manager Wang's concubine. I didn't know that it was Zhang Shan who raised the spirit-stealing rats. He wanted me to get in touch with Manager Wang's bad luck!"

"Since he also has evil intentions, I don't have to hesitate!"

"I will take him to Qinghefang City today and kill him together with the people from the Demonic Blood Sect! By the way, I will exchange this for the cultivation method of the main chapter of Blood Refining Technique. With the help of his spiritual blood, I can cross the threshold of cultivation and reach the first level of blood refining in one fell swoop!"

Speaking of this, I couldn't help but feel high. I clenched my hands, my red and white hair was flying, and my whole body was filled with fishy wind.

"Baby, I've reached the first level of blood training!"

Listening to his description, Han Yu also felt the twists and turns and hardships.

"Master Tao, it's been a difficult journey for you, and now you finally got what you wanted."

"Yes, I finally got what I wanted!" Li Laodao's eyes were blood red and he stared at Han Yu like a hungry tiger or wolf.

Suddenly realizing that something was wrong, he quickly made a hand gesture, and after a moment he let out a long breath: "This Demonic Blood Sect's technique is almost too fast, but the thirst for blood and restless breath must be covered up with the breath-containing technique at all times."

Han Yu asked: "Why did Master Dao come to see me tonight?"
title_en: Chapter 26 Ask fellow Taoists to teach the Dharma
